milestones.label: Application deadline (course funding deadline, reported by scholarship sites, not confirmed by the funder)
milestones.source_text: Two scholarship sites (scholarshipscentral.com and opportunityinside.com, unofficial) say applicants must apply by the December or January funding deadline of their Oxford course; one gives 8 January 2027 for the Said Business School MBA.

milestones.label: Online interviews for shortlisted candidates (reported by scholarship sites)
milestones.source_text: Two scholarship sites (unofficial) report that shortlisted candidates are likely interviewed online in April 2027.

milestones.label: Decisions (reported by scholarship sites)
milestones.source_text: Two scholarship sites (unofficial) report decisions are expected by the end of May 2027 and that silence by then means an unsuccessful application.
